correctness.rationale: The norm-loss generator is strictly stable because every eigenmode couples to the sink. In its diagonal spectral basis the integrated density satisfies the full Lyapunov equation, whose constructed real/imaginary components yield the pair inverse-square sum after cancellation of all triple-index fractions. Differentiating N/kappa+2kappa S/N^2 gives a unique minimum. Walsh eigenvectors have flat moduli; binary-index subset sums make all perturbed cube eigenvalues distinct for 0<epsilon<1/(2^d-1), while only same-cardinality gaps vanish linearly in epsilon. Independent exact direct Liouvillian solutions in eight cases and C2,C3,C4 sums agree. This proves each fixed dimension, not a joint d->infty limit.
